'''''Chaerophyllum azoricum''''' is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Apiaceae]], [[endemic]] to the [[Azores]]. It inhabits ''[[Erica azorica|Erica]]'' and ''[[Calluna vulgaris|Calluna]]'' shrubland, natural meadows of altitude, cliffs and slopes, woods of ''[[Pittosporum undulatum|Pittosporum]]'' and roadsides. It is present in four of the nine islands.<ref>{{cite web |title=Chaerophyllum azoricum Trel. |url=https://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/5XMHS |publisher=[[Catalogue of Life]] |access-date=31 March 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Chaerophyllum azoricum Trel. |url=https://acores.flora-on.pt/#/1chaerophyllum+azoricum |publisher=[[Flora-On]] |access-date=31 March 2021}}</ref>
